dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the 2D profile beginning at approximately 65% of the visible longitudinal axis toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle asymmetrical bulge on the left lateral margin at the mid-body; right margin is relatively linear.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median intensity; skin appears moderately reflective with diffuse lighting.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency dark pixel clusters localized at the interface between the skin and water along the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the central light-grey dorsal region and the darker peripheral edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, dark circular focal point on the anterior dorsal surface and a thin, dark longitudinal linear marking on the posterior segment.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear shadow along the posterior midline indicating a structural dorsal ridge or topological indentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark longitudinal linear marking on the posterior dorsal surface.
